_comment_pricing: Standard Global USD per million tokens from AmazonBedrockFoundationModels ap-northeast-2 (price list published 2026-10-12, checked 2026-10-18). Cache read is 0.05x input, like Opus 5.5, not the derived 0.1x; every rate is declared so the table does not depend on derivation. Exact profile prices prevent inheritance by US CRIS: ap-northeast-2 offers only global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5, while us-east-1 also offers us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5, which needs its own prices (checked 2026-10-18).
_comment_sonnet: Uses the EC2 instance role via the default SDK credential chain, not samples. Global routing is not Korean residency. Adaptive thinking is on by default; thinking.type disabled returns 400 (use between_tools, at high effort or below) and enabled+budget_tokens returns 400 (the Bedrock legacy-thinking adapter rewrites only the budget_tokens form). Default effort is high. Forced tool_choice any/tool returns 400, so OpenAI tool_choice required is rejected upstream.
